## 📌 Pull Request Description

Provide a clear and concise description of the changes proposed in this pull request.

### 🛠️ Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance / Reliability improvement
- [ ] 🔒 Security hardening
- [ ] 🏗️ Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) change
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update

---

### 🧪 Testing & Verification
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated
- [ ] All unit tests pass locally (`make test` or `pytest`)
- [ ] Flake8 & Black lint checks pass (`make lint`)
- [ ] Terraform validation passes (`make tf-validate`)

---

### 🛡️ Security & Compliance
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or credentials committed
- [ ] Least-privilege IAM policies maintained
- [ ] Encryption at rest / in transit preserved
- [ ] Security scanners pass (`bandit`, `checkov`)

---

### 📸 Screenshots / Outputs (if applicable)
Add relevant screenshots, CLI outputs, or CloudWatch dashboard graphs.
